rows.summary: This cycle incorporates new evidence on autonomous decision-making risks (CBRN domain) into existing projects. Findings indicate that catastrophic failure in high-stakes environments often stems from agent trade-offs between helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty, necessitating more robust self-correction and cross-turn state continuity. Notebooks for all three projects have been revised to reflect these insights.
rows.title: Synthesizing High-Stakes Failure Modes and Agent Continuity
